sources.title: Naga City Ordinance No. 2003-003, Section 6
sources.note: Enacted January 15, 2003. Lists the Naga Metropolitan Cathedral and its convent among the historical buildings and structures declared for preservation.

sources.title: Philippine Registry of Cultural Property (NCCA): Naga City entries
sources.note: Inspected October 8, 2026. Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint John the Evangelist of Naga: NHCP marked structure and local cultural property under Ordinance No. 2003-003. The registry listing is the basis for this landmark's Heritage legend membership.

text.en: Bishop Bernardo de la Concepción began construction of the present cathedral in 1808.
The cathedral was finished and blessed in 1843 by Monsignor Tomás Ladron de Guevara.
An 1887 earthquake damaged the cathedral; repairs followed in 1890 under Bishop Arsenio Campo and engineer Ricardo Ayuso.
